system.description:
Yomi cannot be dispelled while Enmamon is on the field, but is automatically dispelled in the event Enmamon is no longer an active combatant.

While <Yomi> is active, all non-Enmamon creatures gain @Affliction[destined], which remains for as long as Yomi is active, and treats Enmamon as the source of @Affliction[destined].

Additionally, all creatures become @Affliction[exposed] until <Yomi> is dispelled or combat ends.
